concurrency_audit_summary.test_environment: Staging / Local Test Bench (PHP 8.3 CLI Built-in / Laragon Apache, Remote PostgreSQL Tokyo)
concurrency_audit_summary.testing_protocol: Non-destructive concurrency probing using multi-worker HTTP request dispatch on read & registration mock routes
concurrency_audit_summary.primary_failure_threshold: 25 Concurrent Users (Document tracking number sequence collision)

concurrency_tiers.observations: Requests completed successfully without deadlock, but response latency elevated due to remote Tokyo connection latency.
16 duplicate key exceptions triggered in DocumentService::generateTrackingNumber due to concurrent Document::max('document_id') read collisions.
PostgreSQL connection limits saturated; lock wait timeouts observed during DocumentTrackingController::receive lockForUpdate row contention.
Omitted in accordance with non-destructive audit rules. Current Supabase pool limit (60 connections) would cause cascade denial of service.

concurrency_vulnerabilities.issue: Phantom Reads in Tracking Number Generation
concurrency_vulnerabilities.risk: Fails to lock rows that do not yet exist, allowing duplicate tracking numbers to be generated simultaneously
concurrency_vulnerabilities.remedy: PostgreSQL SEQUENCE or dedicated atomic counter table

concurrency_vulnerabilities.risk: High contention and lock wait timeout when multiple clerks scan batches simultaneously
concurrency_vulnerabilities.remedy: Shorten transaction duration, commit early, decouple audit logging to queue
